title: Require snapshot-checkable criteria in briefs and structure-pass §5
summary: Add to the reader brief and the producer brief a rule that each acceptance criterion is checkable from the snapshot, the diff or commands the verifier runs. Rewrite docs/design/structure-pass.md section 5 so the caller-check evidence (and similar report-held proof) lives in a committed file or test. Audience: the verifier that judges jobs, and maintainers reading the design doc.

defaults_applied.how: New tests for both briefs; fmt, clippy and test criterion.
Criteria run tests that render the briefs and check their text.
One rule, two briefs, one doc section.
The check is the rule appearing in the rendered briefs, not the edit being made.
Doc and brief text written for an outside reader.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs (reader_brief at ~2256 with the 'Criteria evidence' rule line at ~2230 and 'What the verifier can run' at ~2429; producer_brief_with_evidence at ~626 calling criteria_check_section at ~746; existing test the_reader_brief_says_the_verifier_never_sees_the_producers_report at ~4588) and crates/athena-core/src/reading/checks.rs (check_criteria_evidence). No record or data file is added under crates/, so the records allow-list is not touched. The property is measured directly by rendering the brief strings and asserting on their text.

The reader brief already says criteria rest on commands the verifier can check; the change makes the stated rule explicit (snapshot, diff or commands) with a test, and adds it to the producer brief. It does not add a refusal check, so no refusal-rate change is intended.
The reader prompt file prompts/reader.md has 3 tokens of headroom and the verifier prompt 2, so the rule goes in the Rust-built briefs, not in prompt files.
CHANGELOG.md gets one line if the repo convention requires it; no governance file (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) changes.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test -p athena-context`: a new test renders the reader brief via reader_brief and asserts it contains the rule that every acceptance criterion must be checkable from the snapshot, diff or commands the verifier runs; the test and all existing tests pass.

Run `cargo test -p athena-context`: a new test renders producer_brief for a reading and asserts it contains the same rule, in a section that tells the producer to make its evidence a file or test in the snapshot; it passes.

Grep for `Caller check` in docs/design/structure-pass.md shows item 5 of section 5 requires the old-path Grep counts to be put in the snapshot (a committed file or test) and no longer asks for them in a report; Grep `report` in section 5 shows no remaining requirement whose evidence lives only in a report or change description.

`git diff` shows the existing reader brief wording and the left-to-Athena handling in the producer brief are unchanged apart from the added rule; no prompt file under crates/athena-context/prompts changes.
Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` from the repository root; all pass with no new #[allow].
No unrelated behavior changes: `git diff --stat` lists only briefs.rs, structure-pass.md and optionally CHANGELOG.md.

out_of_scope: Changing check_criteria_evidence or any refusal logic
Changing the moves G1-G8 and R1-R9 described in structure-pass.md, only the evidence rules of section 5
urgent_reason: Cuts failed or rejected attempts caused by criteria the verifier cannot check.
hard_reason: Changes the run pipeline's briefs, which tell the reader and producer how jobs are judged, so a mistake is hard to see.
